name: Pinpoint glue roller pen
summary: A fine roller tip that lays down a thin, even line of quick-drying glue.
description:
The roller tip puts glue exactly where a fold needs it: along a tab, under a flap, on the point of a crane's beak. It dries fast and clear, so small hands can keep folding instead of waiting.

Resin body, 14.5 cm long and 1 cm across, about 10 g. One pen per order.

name: EZ glue pen
summary: Solid glue in a pen-shaped twist stick. High tack, no drips.
description:
A slim stick of solid, high-tack glue in a pen body. Twist it up, draw a line, cap it. Nothing runs, nothing puddles, and paper lies flat when it dries.

Good for paper, card and stickers. One pen per order.

name: Glitter glue, set of 10
summary: Ten fine-nozzle tubes of liquid glitter glue for finishing touches.
description:
Ten colours of liquid glitter glue in tubes with fine nozzles, for outlining, writing names and putting a shine on finished models.

Dries in about 20 minutes. Washable from skin; keep away from fabric while wet.

name: Character glue sticks, set of 4
summary: Four small PVA glue sticks with friendly faces. Quick-drying and pencil-case sized.
description:
Four 9 g PVA glue sticks, each 7.7 × 1.8 cm, in four character designs. The PVA dries quickly with little smudging, so a page or a model can be handled almost at once.

For paper making, scrapbooking and school work.

name: High-strength kids' glue sticks
summary: Non-toxic, twist-up solid glue that holds card as well as paper.
description:
A thicker, stronger solid glue for card, folded tabs and models that get played with. Safe and non-toxic, and it lasts.

Each stick is 8 × 1.9 cm, 9 g, plastic body with PVA solid glue. Choose a pack of 1, 3 or 5.

name: Iridescent glitter paper
summary: 15 cm squares that shift colour as they turn. For stars, cranes and backgrounds.
description:
Square sheets with an iridescent glitter face that changes colour in the light. Sturdy enough to hold a crisp crease, thin enough for a crane.

Each sheet is 15 × 15 cm. Mixed colours in every pack.

name: Double-sided origami paper, 100 sheets
summary: A different colour on each side, in three sizes. Folds easily, holds a crease, won't tear.
description:
One hundred sheets with a different colour on each side, so the inside of a fold shows. Ten bright colours help younger folders tell the steps apart.

Three sizes in every pack: 7, 10 and 15 cm squares. Made without any chemical smell. Good for cranes, planes, roses, dinosaurs, flowers and hearts.

name: Patterned origami paper, 72 sheets
summary: Twelve printed patterns, six sheets of each, in 15 cm squares.
description:
Seventy-two 15 cm squares printed with twelve patterns: flowers, waves, checks and dots, six sheets of each. Patterned paper turns a plain crane into a gift.

Safe, environmentally friendly paper.

name: Elephant asleep on the moon
summary: A 3D papercraft kit: a sleeping elephant curled into a crescent moon.
description:
Pre-printed card pieces that you score, fold and glue into a faceted sculpture of an elephant asleep in a crescent moon. It makes a calm piece for a shelf or a bedroom.

Difficulty 3 of 6. You will need a craft knife, a ruler and glue. Some kits include a 3D guide best read on a computer.

name: Raccoon in the moon
summary: A 3D papercraft kit: a raccoon tucked into a crescent moon.
description:
Pre-printed card pieces that you score, fold and glue into a faceted raccoon resting in a crescent moon.

Difficulty 3 of 6. You will need a craft knife, a ruler and glue. Some kits include a 3D guide best read on a computer.

name: Panda asleep on the moon
summary: A 3D papercraft kit: a panda dozing in a crescent moon.
description:
Pre-printed card pieces that you score, fold and glue into a faceted panda dozing in a crescent moon.

Difficulty 3 of 6. You will need a craft knife, a ruler and glue. Some kits include a 3D guide best read on a computer.

name: Fox asleep on the moon
summary: A 3D papercraft kit: a fox curled up asleep in a crescent moon.
description:
Pre-printed card pieces that you score, fold and glue into a faceted fox curled up in a crescent moon. Paper models take patience, and this one repays it.

Difficulty 3 of 6. You will need a craft knife, a ruler and glue. Some kits include a 3D guide best read on a computer.
